title: Cookie & Tracking Policy
bannerMessage: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze website traffic, and personalize content.
content:
## 1. Introduction & Scope
This Cookie Policy explains how our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies (such as web beacons, pixels, and local storage) when you visit our website or interact with our online services.

Cookies help us make our platform secure, fast, and personalized. By continuing to use our website, you consent to our use of cookies in accordance with this policy.

---

## 2. What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small data files placed on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when you visit a website. They are widely used by web developers to make websites work efficiently, remember your preferences, and provide analytical reporting data.

* **First-Party Cookies:** Set directly by our domain.
* **Third-Party Cookies:** Set by our partner service providers (such as analytics, payment processors, and CDNs).
* **Session Cookies:** Temporary cookies that expire when you close your browser.
* **Persistent Cookies:** Remain on your device for a specified period or until manually deleted.

---

## 3. Types of Cookies We Use

### A. Strictly Necessary Cookies (Always Active)
These cookies are essential for you to navigate the website and use its core features, such as accessing secure areas, maintaining session authentication, and preventing cross-site request forgery (CSRF).

### B. Performance & Analytics Cookies
These cookies collect aggregated information about how visitors interact with our website (e.g., which pages are visited most often, bounce rates, and error logs). We use this data to improve platform performance and optimize page load speeds.

### C. Functionality & Preference Cookies
These cookies enable our website to remember choices you make (such as your preferred theme, language selection, or regional settings) and provide enhanced, personalized features.

### D. Targeting & Advertising Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by advertising partners to build a profile of your interests and display relevant advertisements on third-party websites.

---

## 4. How to Manage and Disable Cookies
You can control and manage your cookie preferences at any time:
1. **Via Our Cookie Banner:** Click "Cookie Preferences" to customize non-essential cookie categories.
2. **Via Your Web Browser:** Most web browsers allow you to view, manage, delete, and block cookies through their settings:
   * Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and Security → Cookies and other site data
   * Mozilla Firefox: Options → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
   * Apple Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Block all cookies
   * Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and Site Permissions

---

## 5. Updates to This Cookie Policy
We may update this policy periodically to reflect changes in our legal obligations or operational practices. When changes occur, the **Last Updated** date at the top of this document will be updated.

## 6. Contact Information
If you have any questions regarding our use of cookies or tracking technologies, please contact our compliance team at **privacy@yourcompany.com**.
